text:
deploybot: Starting catalog enable for model `harbor-13b-v2-quant` in prod/us-west. Change window 03:00-04:00 UTC. Plan: canary 5% -> 20% -> 50% with 30m stabilization windows. Fallback ordering default: quant_v2 -> quant_v1 -> base_v1. Pin policy: enterprise accounts tagged `compliance:high` remain pinned to quant_v1. See snippet below for the pin/fallback map. Please ACK if you’re watching. :rocket:

ana: acked — I'll be watching p50/p95 latency and the SLO dash.

pranav: quick ask — can we make the fallback region-aware? prefer quant_v1 in eu due to known perf. Suggest YAML change:```yaml
fallback_order:
  - region: us-*
    order: [quant_v2, quant_v1, base_v1]
  - region: eu-*
    order: [quant_v1, quant_v2, base_v1]
```

deploybot: @pranav good call — apply regional override during canary. Updated config staged.

lee: adding note — internal-testing org should be pinned to `harbor-13b-v2-quant:canary` so we can hit it with stress tests. Command: `rwdctl catalog pin --org internal-testing --model harbor-13b-v2-quant:canary`

maria: rollback criteria I care about: +3% absolute error rate or sustained +10% p95 latency for 10m. If either triggers, we rollback to quant_v1 and open a postmortem.

eng-oncall-bot: Alert rule added: `catalog.error_rate > 1.5 * baseline` for 10m => #eng-oncall paging.

ops-sre: I'll be on-call for rollback steps. Short checklist: 1) Pause rollout 2) Pin traffic to fallback variant 3) Run sanity queries 4) Notify customers/CS.

deploybot: CANARY STARTED @ 03:05 UTC (5% traffic). Rolling windows active. Deploy logs: `deploybot://catalog/4598765432/canary`

(20m later)
deploybot: Canary metrics update: p95 +1.2%, errors steady at baseline, cost +8% — no safety trip. Ramping to 20% in 5m. :thumbsup:

ana: seeing slight KV cache evictions in prod-host-42, but nothing hitting latency SLOs. Monitoring.

maria: standing by. If we hit the error threshold I'll call rollback.

(40m later)
deploybot: RAMP COMPLETE: 50% traffic. No regressions flagged. Scheduling full rollout to 100% in next maint window unless objections.

pranav: Nice. Can we gate full rollout behind a final smoke run next hour? small request.

deploybot: noted — gating on a 5m smoke run at 60% traffic next hour. Will post results here.

ops-sre: thanks everyone, leave notes in the cutover doc and tag me for any urgent rollbacks. :eyes:
